prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-resolution polished UI COMPONENT KIT REFERENCE BOARD for Hermit, a friendly business-paperwork roadmap app. This is a flat front-facing Figma-ready design reference, not a device mockup or website screenshot. Large landscape canvas with excellent readable typography, generous spacing, crisp vector-like UI edges, aligned grid, consistent sizes. Background pale blue-white #F6FAFE. White component surfaces, pale sky blue #D8EBFC, restrained accent blue #7FB7E4 and deeper blue #2463D4, dark navy text #111827, secondary gray text #52606D, subtle cool borders. Primary buttons dark navy with white labels; pale blue selection fills. Modern readable system-sans typography, lightly rounded 12px corners, minimal soft shadows. No decorative illustrations, gradients, 3D, logos from other brands, browser chrome or devices. Header at top: 'Hermit' and 'Component kit' with small subtitle 'Clear steps. Calm interfaces.' Arrange five distinctly labelled spacious sections on the board, with no overlaps. Section 1 'Buttons': a row of realistic buttons 'Continue' (dark filled), 'Back' (white outlined), 'View source' (text link), a disabled 'Continue', and a 'Saving...' button with a small spinner. Section 2 'Inputs': labelled 'Business name' empty field with placeholder 'Enter business name'; a filled field 'Business name' showing 'My Manila Shop'; a focused blue-border field 'Barangay'; an error field 'Business name' with red fine border and helper 'Enter a business name.'; and a small textarea labelled 'Notes' with placeholder 'Add a note...'. Labels remain above fields, not inside them. Section 3 'Selection cards': two roomy single-choice cards 'Sole proprietorship' and 'Partnership', with radio circles, the first selected using pale blue fill and blue border; beneath them three compact multi-choice cards 'Retail', 'Food service', 'Repair' with checkbox icons, first two selected. Small unselected option 'I\u2019m not sure'. Section 4 'Badges': distinct compact readable badges 'Not started', 'Preparing', 'Submitted', 'Completed', and separate outlined indicators 'Blocked' and 'Needs confirmation'. Use restrained gray, blue, green and amber only where semantic, text/icons must distinguish every status. Section 5 'Task cards': two larger excellent UI cards. First header 'Your next action', task title 'Review your business details', supporting sentence 'Confirm your answers to clarify your roadmap.', dark button 'Review details'. Second title 'Example requirement', status badge 'Preparing', short lines 'Prerequisite: Review your business details' and 'Issuing office: To be confirmed', fine divider, source row 'Official source' and 'Review date: Not yet reviewed', small outlined button 'View task'. The example requirement is clearly illustrative, no real legal deadlines, no certification seal, no fake verified government claims. Put a small footer 'Design reference \u00b7 Illustrative content'. Keep the entire board coherent, restrained and practical: a real reusable design system sheet that can be manually recreated in Figma, with strong contrast and accurately spelled English UI labels. All five requested component groups must be visible and recognizable. Prioritize clear labelled examples over large decorative headings.
